idea-plugin.name: Motadata Runtime Governance (MVP)
idea-plugin.description:
M3.4 IDE Plugin Integration — Runtime-governed JetBrains plugin.
Routes all governed IDE actions through the runtime Plan-Gate: - VCS commit interception (shadow/enforcing modes) - Ask Motadata AI (PLAN ONLY, no execution) - Submit to Runtime (governed execution request)
Surfaces distinct governance outcomes: REFUSED, DEFERRED, BOUNDED_ALLOW, BLOCKED, EXECUTED
No IDE action of interest bypasses runtime governance. Fails closed when runtime unavailable in enforcing mode.

action.description: Submit action for governed execution through runtime Plan-Gate
